changes: Bonded inserts in solid foam can start the supported coupled solve; unsupported sliding foam contact remains refused.
Actual deformed chord/thickness plane determines section-relative geometric incidence; 241 stations plus geometry/beam stations.

Numerical admission and angle-policy acceptance have separate result fields. Beyond the 8 degree warning the result is diagnostic only; beyond 15 degrees it is also explicitly outside the refusal limit. Neither threshold is a measured stall boundary.
Matched rigid/flexible freestream-normal lift and sign-change diagnostics; no inferred stability certificate.
Construction-aware one-way guidance, selected-flow stiffness labels, Reissner scope and conservative shear-bound labels.
tests: Native imported bonded foam rods/spars and unsupported contact cases
Section-angle sign, oblique rigid-rotation invariance, spanwise projection and policy thresholds
Controller shows diagnostic angle refusal even when numerical checks pass
Full 900 mm foam-spars 30 m/s regression: numerical checks may pass but angle-policy acceptance must fail
Original 15 m/s rods/spars displacement values preserved within 0.0001 mm
provenance_note: Earlier kit receipts retain their actual source commits; they are not silently restamped. The matched-case workflow re-executes the native physics for this release.
limits: No stall, material failure, flutter or divergence certificate
Nonconvergence is not labelled proof of physical divergence
A conservative shear bound is not actual error
